SELECT fin.finprod_market_id shortName, fin.finprod_name productName, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%y') yearId, case fin.ccy when 'CNY' then 'RMB' else fin.ccy end as currencyId, case pafin.deal_mode when '01' then '10' when '02' then '20' when '03' then '30' when '04' then '30' when '05' then '41' when '06' then '40' when '07' then '40' when '08' then '40' when '09' then '50' else '10' end as cycleMode, fin.FINPROD_ABBR as prodName, IFNULL(finadd.close_days, 1) cycleDays, finadd.is_cycle isCycle, case finadd.sale_department when '01' then '1' else '0' end as isPreAllot, '1' interestMode, '0' interestModeChg, '1' endInstruct, '0' endInstructChg, '0' isExpire, psale.First_sale_mdate-psale.First_sale_vdate + 1 saleDayNum,
DATE_FORMAT(psale.First_sale_vdate, '%Y%m%d') saleStartDate, DATE_FORMAT(psale.First_sale_mdate, '%Y%m%d') saleEndDate, DATE_FORMAT(psale.First_sale_mdate, '%Y%m%d') bailDate, DATE_FORMAT(fin.vdate, '%Y%m%d') startDate,
case pafin.deal_mode when '03' then DATE_FORMAT(fin.vdate + finadd.close_days, '%Y%m%d') when '04' then DATE_FORMAT(fin.vdate + finadd.close_days, '%Y%m%d') else DATE_FORMAT(fin.mdate, '%Y%m%d') end as endDate,
case pafin.deal_mode when '03' then DATE_FORMAT(fin.vdate + finadd.close_days + 2, '%Y%m%d') when '04' then DATE_FORMAT(fin.vdate + finadd.close_days + 2, '%Y%m%d') else DATE_FORMAT(fin.mdate, '%Y%m%d')
end as allotDate,
'0000' saleStartTime, '2357' saleEndTime, '0700' bailTime, '0830' rtStartTime, '1800' rtEndTime, '0' fixInvestType, '0' isChgCust, '3' riskLevel, '999999999' allAmounttLmt, '00' quoteType, '00' relateType, case finadd.PROFIT_FLAG when '02' then '1' when '01' then '0' else '1' end as navMode,
'0' isCarry, '1.00000000' netValue, '1.00000000' lastNetValue, DATE_FORMAT(fin.vdate, '%Y%m%d') navDate, finadd.PROFIT_FLAG rateType, (CASE WHEN finadd.is_lay='Y' THEN (SELECT min(prdlay.yield) FROM PRD_LAYER_PARAM prdlay WHERE prdlay.finprod_id = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ELSE (SELECT prdlay.yield FROM PRD_LAYER_PARAM prdlay WHERE prdlay.finprod_id = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) END) as planRate,
'以产品说明书为准' planRateRemark, case cashrule.basis when 'A/360' then '360' else '365' end as interestBaseDays, '0' feeMode, '0.0' buyFeeRate, '0.0' drawFeeRate, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') buildDateTime, fin.create_dept buildDept, IFNULL(cashrule.yield, 0) saleFeeRate, IFNULL(psale.toff_start, 0) minAmount, '9999999999' maxAmount, IFNULL(psale.toff_start, 0) minLeaveAmount, IFNULL(psale.lowest_amt, 0) unitAmount, IFNULL (finadd.PROD_REGIST_CODE, fin.finprod_market_id) ProductNo, fin.remark remark, fin.issue_type issuetype, fin.ENTRUSTER branchId
FROM fin_product fin left join fin_product_add finadd on fin.FINPROD_ID = finadd.FINPROD_ID left join PA_FIN_PRODUCT pafin on fin.FINPROD_ID = pafin.FINPROD_ID left join PRD_SALE_PARAM psale on fin.FINPROD_ID = psale.FINPROD_ID left join ( select crule.basis, crule.yield, crule.eff_date, crule.finprod_id from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE crule, FIN_CASH_INFO info where info.cash_id = crule.cash_id and info.FINPROD_TYPE = #{prodType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and info.finprod_id = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and info.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and info.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and crule.eff_date=( select max(crule.eff_date) from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE crule2 where crule2.cash_id = info.cash_id and DATE_FORMAT(crule2.eff_date, '%Y%m%d') <= #{sysDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) ) cashrule on cashrule.finprod_id = fin.FINPROD_ID where fin.FINPROD_ID = pafin.FINPROD_ID AND fin.FINPROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
